limits: CPU fixtures do not establish native MuJoCo/CUDA passivity or reproduce the original GPU anomaly.
If both initial reader and all journaling fail, dead and last_abort are retained in memory only; a separately reviewed outer must retain the fatal exit/error.
Original performance timers remain in their original AST positions; passive observations add CPU/I/O wall time and are not valid O2A timing.
A separately reviewed one-attempt outer, source identity admission, reservation, and root registration are still required before any GPU invocation.
